templates.name: fit_subsidy_nudge
templates.body:
Hi {{1}}, planning to expand or shift your unit in the next year?

Under Haryana's 2026 MSME policy, new plots at *FIT Rohtak* are in the *Sub-Prime* area category, so your unit can get:
• 25% capital subsidy, up to ₹3.5 crore (thrust sectors)
• 75% stamp duty refund on the plot
• 7% interest subsidy, up to ₹25 lakh a year
• 50 to 60% SGST back for 7 years

FIT is a DTCP-licensed, RERA-approved industrial township at Kalanaur, with plots from 500 sq yd.

Tap *Check my subsidies* for your industry, or ask our AI bot anything.
